00113| export function checkedRoutePrecedence() {

00115|   if (declared.length !== PLANNER_ROUTE_ARMS.length) {
00116|     throw new Error(agenticMessage('planner_precedence_count', { declared: declared.length, coded: PLANNER_ROUTE_ARMS.length }));

00118|   PLANNER_ROUTE_ARMS.forEach(([fn, name], index) => {
00119|     if (declared[index] !== name) {

00132|   // A copy or move followed by edits of the file it makes is planned sentence
00133|   // by sentence (PR #1188 G82).

00135|     ?? (await workspaceChange.planWorkspaceChangeStep(task, messages, toolNames))
00136|     ?? (await moduleFunction.planModuleFunctionStep(task, messages, toolNames))

00138|     // rewritten (PR #1188 T93).

00141|     // form, and the file is run (PR #1188 G13).

00155|   if (codeArtifact.explicitSubstitutionQuery(task) !== null) return null;

00190|   const received = latestUserRequest(messages);
00191|   if (received === null) return null;
00192|   const summary = harnessEnvelope.summarizeRequest(received);
00193|   if (summary !== null) return finalAnswer(summary);

00196|   const plan = restart ?? await planChatStepRoutes(messages, toolNames, received);
00197|   if (plan === null) return null;

00201| /** Mirrors `fn stop_repeated_call` in rust/src/agentic_coding/planner.rs. */
00202| function stopRepeatedCall(plan, messages) {
00203|   if (!isToolCalls(plan)) return plan;
00204|   const progress = Progress.scan(messages);
00205|   for (const call of plan.calls) {
00206|     const attempt = progress.repeatedCall(call);
00207|     if (attempt) {
00208|       return finalAnswer(fill('stuck_step_report', [
00209|         ['{step}', `${call.tool} ${call.arguments}`],
00210|         ['{result}', attempt.detail.trim()],
00211|       ]));
00212|     }
00213|   }
00214|   return plan;
00215| }

00218| function stopRepeatedFailure(plan, messages) {
00219|   const REPEATED_FAILURES_THAT_STOP = 2;
00220|   if (!isToolCalls(plan)) return plan;
00221|   const progress = Progress.scan(messages);
00222|   const repeated = plan.calls.find((call) => progress.identicalFailuresOf(call.tool) >= REPEATED_FAILURES_THAT_STOP);
00223|   if (!repeated) return plan;
00224|   const failure = progress.latestFailureOfTool(repeated.tool);
00225|   if (!failure) return plan;

00227|   return finalAnswer(toolResult.renderFailure(repeated.tool, failure.detail, prompt));

00257|     if (rerouted !== null) return rerouted;

00269|   for (const arm of [gitCommit.planCommitStep, planWorkspaceChangeArm, codeTask.planGeneratedSourceStep, structuredEdit.planStructuredEditStep, structuredDocument.planStep]) {
00270|     const plan = await arm(task, messages, toolNames);

00281|   const obligations = capabilityRouter.workspaceCreationTool(toolNames) !== null && !shellOwned

00286|     if (next && (next.kind === 'observe' || next.kind === 'decompose')) {
00287|       const general = composeGeneralChangePlan(next.node.clause);
00288|       return general === null ? null : await planGeneralChangeStep(messages, toolNames, general);

00295|         const general = composeGeneralChangePlan(obligation.clause);

00311|   if (report !== null) return learningReport.planReportStep(report, messages, toolNames);
00312|   const artifact = await codeArtifact.planCodeArtifactStep(task, messages, toolNames);
00313|   if (artifact !== null) return artifact;

00316|     [dreamingAudit.isDreamingAuditTask, documentRecipe.planDreamingAuditStep],
00317|     [selfAst.isSelfAstTask, documentRecipe.planSelfAstStep],
00318|     [sourceLinks.isSourceLinksTask, documentRecipe.planSourceLinksStep],
00319|     [ledger.isLedgerTask, documentRecipe.planLedgerStep],
00320|     [explain.isExplainTask, documentRecipe.planExplainStep],
00321|     [changeRequest.isChangeRequestTask, documentRecipe.planChangeRequestStep],
00322|     [repairStrategy.isRepairStrategyTask, documentRecipe.planRepairStrategyStep],
00323|     [rebuildPlan.isRebuildTask, documentRecipe.planRebuildStep],
00324|     [googleTrendsLearning.isGoogleTrendsLearningTask, documentRecipe.planGoogleTrendsLearningStep],

00349| /** The second half of `plan_settled_routes`, from `follow_up_answer` on. */
00350| async function planLaterRoutes(task, messages, toolNames) {
00351|   const followUp = toolResult.followUpAnswer(messages, task);
00352|   if (followUp !== null) return finalAnswer(followUp);

00357|     if (query === null) return finalAnswer(webResearch.definitionFollowupClarification(task));
00358|     const plan = await webResearch.planWebResearchStep(messages, toolNames, query, true);
00359|     if (plan !== null) return plan;
00360|   }
00361|   const edit = await intentRouter.planEditStep(task, messages, toolNames);
00362|   if (edit !== null) return edit;
00363|   if (toolFor(toolNames, Capability.Read) !== null) {
00364|     const fileTask = fileReadTaskFor(task);

00388|     return planShellStep(messages, toolNames, command);

00392|   if (formalizationRecipe.isFormalizationTask(task)) {

00400| /** The tail of `plan_settled_routes`, from `workspace_inspection` on. */
00401| async function planOpenRoutes(task, messages, toolNames) {
00402|   if (!toolResult.hasLatestTurnResult(messages)) {
00403|     const search = workspaceInspection.workspaceInspectionSearchForTask(task);
00404|     const tool = search === null ? null : toolFor(toolNames, Capability.Grep);
00405|     if (tool !== null) {
00406|       const args = { query: search.query, pattern: search.pattern };
00407|       if (search.include !== null && search.include !== undefined) args.include = search.include;
00408|       return planOne(tool, jsonText(args));
00409|     }
00410|   }
00411|   const structure = await taskStructure.planTaskStructureStep(messages, task);
00412|   if (structure !== null) return structure;
00413|   if (!webResearch.hasSuccessfulSearchResult(messages)) {
00414|     const routed = await capabilityRouter.planRoutedCapabilityStep(task, messages, toolNames, capabilityRouter.RoutingStage.NamedOrLocal);
00415|     if (routed !== null) return routed;
